name: Heart Unlocked
source:
An otome fan game for the Identity V game jam 2024 featuring Lockheart and other characters in the Truth and Inference universe.

[From [url=https://nelleline.itch.io/idv-heart-unlocked-demo]Itch.io[/url]]

为“2024《第五人格》同人游戏创作节”制作的乙女同人游戏，由“心锁”及《真理之下》平行世界中的其他角色领衔登场。

[摘自[url=https://nelleline.itch.io/idv-heart-unlocked-demo]itch.io[/url]]
